description: This file defines a utility class 'Linters' that facilitates running code linters (black and ruff) on Python files within a specified directory. It includes methods for initializing the linter runner, printing separators, and executing the linters with optional flags. The class leverages external modules such as shutil, subprocess, pathlib, and custom modules for console output and environment configuration.

classes.name: Linters
classes.description: A class to run code linters like black and ruff on a given directory.

methods.name: run( self, linter: Literal["black", "ruff"], flags: Optional[List[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Executes a specified linter ('black' or 'ruff') with optional flags on Python files in the directory.

methods.name: black(self)
methods.description: Runs the 'black' code formatter on the directory with appropriate flags based on verbosity and environment.

methods.name: ruff(self)
methods.description: Runs the 'ruff' linter/formatter on the directory with appropriate flags.
